task: Parse an AWS CloudFormation template and extract all resource logical IDs
solution_criteria: Function should take a JSON string as input and return a list of all logical IDs (keys under 'Resources' section)

task: Validate an AWS IAM policy JSON to ensure it has required top-level keys (Version, Statement)
solution_criteria: JSON schema should define a valid IAM policy structure with Version and Statement as required fields, Statement as array of objects

task: Extract AWS account ID from an ARN string using regex
solution_criteria: Pattern should match and capture the 12-digit account ID from standard AWS ARN format (arn:aws:service:region:account-id:resource)

task: Convert AWS CLI response timestamps from ISO 8601 format to Unix epoch timestamp
solution_criteria: Function should accept an ISO 8601 datetime string and return integer Unix timestamp; must handle timezone information correctly

task: Identify all S3 bucket names in a CloudFormation template that have public read access enabled
solution_criteria: Function should parse CloudFormation JSON and return bucket logical IDs where PublicAccessBlockConfiguration allows public access or PublicRead is set
